user_preferences: Dedicated local-only voice system; automatic Mumble startup without PC or internet.
Keep phone mobile data ENABLED. It was restored and cellular data confirmed active after the user urgently requested restoration.
Do not disable mobile data to troubleshoot HaLow or route Mumble traffic.
Use tap-to-cycle Status/Logs/Processes with cyan TacComms header and visible Admin/Lock buttons.
Admin requires six-digit PIN; emergency lock requires confirmation and a separate six-digit recovery PIN; calls continue while locked.
PINs enrolled on the Pi; never reuse a PIN typed in old conversation history.
60-second display sleep must switch the backlight off and preserve stylus-tap wake.
Central filtering on Pi is desired, prioritizing voice intelligibility during loud impulses.
User will supply proper hearing-protection equipment; headset model remains unfinalized.
No full-disk encryption selected; preserve unattended boot.
